item.title: Contra Proferentem Rule in Various Jurisdictions
item.description: 🔹 Preface: Why This Rule Matters I asked AI (ChatGPT-4o) to explain how the contra proferentem rule operates across various jurisdictions. But before I share its reply, let me briefly explain why this rule matters — and why you should care. 🔹 What Is Contra Proferentem? (Very Brief Explanation) Contra proferentem is a legal rule.
